name: portal-display
comment: BlockPortal.randomDisplayTick (BlockPortal.java:157-184) under World.randomDisplayUpdates: a 7x5x7 block of portal blocks (id 90) filled silently (fill does not notify, so no frame is needed) next to a player at (-1.5, 61, -1.5), outside the portal (onEntityCollidedWithBlock is not reached). randomDisplayUpdates draws its 6000 positions from World.rand and hands the portal blocks it hits the unseeded `new Random()` of World.java:1999 (census: only particles and sounds, not traced), so what this pins is that randomDisplayTick draws nothing from World.rand and changes no block: rng_state every tick, the portal block at the end.
